description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2039/11 of 04.10.2017 - Cad. Map No. 520006 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and amendments to land extent measurements and particulars. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and involves land title settlement matters, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
